Definition: Implied equicorrelation proxy from DIA and point-in-time Dow constituent straddle IVs; realized weighted equicorrelation from uncentered return second moments over sessions t+2 through t+6. Monthly means plotted by label/exit month; mean gap equally weights paired daily observations. No clipping.
Source: Market Data options; LSEG underlying returns and point-in-time weights. Overlapping horizons; descriptive statistics, not independent samples.
ImpliedTenor: Option expiry nearest 30 calendar days, permitted range 14–70 days; not a five-day implied-correlation forecast.
